text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat on the day, holding their levels as the broader market treads water. Fear & Greed remains elevated at 34 despite a mild 4-point weekly gain, suggesting traders are still cautious and not yet convinced of a sustained move higher. With BTC dominance at 56.1% and total volume at $31B—modest relative to recent peaks—the market is displaying neither conviction nor capitulation; it's a patient wait for directional clarity.
